content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen has no photo and the socket illustration below the fold is followed by a large dead band before the '2006' block; 'Navodila za pot' appears twice within the first screen (header and hero).","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works with the socket illustration, but a tall empty band sits beneath the hero and the '2006' numeral plus two blank-canvas timelines leave big voids.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Tighten vertical rhythm: remove the empty band between the socket illustration and the '2006' block on phone and between hero and 'Delamo od leta' on desktop.","Drop the duplicate 'Navodila za pot' links in the hero (header already has it) and the duplicated phone/email in the footer below the dark contact block.","Replace or complement the socket illustration with a real photo of the master at work, and shrink the '2006' numeral so it does not swallow a full screen on phone."],"blockers":["Phone, below hero: a large empty band between the socket illustration and the 'Delamo od leta' block reads as a broken layout.","Phone and desktop: 'Navodila za pot' repeated in header and hero, and phone/email repeated in the dark contact block and footer."]}
